主要内容: On May 11, 2020, Novavax, Inc. (NASDAQ: NVAX) entered into a restated funding agreement with the Coalition for Epidemic Preparedness Innovations (CEPI), under which CEPI will provide up to $384.5 million to support the development of NVX-CoV2373, its coronavirus vaccine candidate against SARS-CoV-2. The agreement allows Novavax to borrow up to $145.2 million in forgivable no-interest term loans to prepay manufacturing activities, contingent on vaccine sales. The funding supports clinical development through Phase 2, rapid scale-up of vaccine manufacturing, and increased production of the Matrix-M adjuvant. The scope and continuation of the agreement may be modified based on ongoing developments of the COVID-19 outbreak and the success of NVX-CoV2373 relative to other third-party vaccine candidates. If a third-party product is deemed to have substantially greater potential, Novavax must cease its clinical trial in the relevant region and will be reimbursed for any costs incurred.
